sections.label: Market size and dynamics
sections.heading: Market size and dynamics
sections.description: How big the market is, how it is segmented, and how demand is changing.

sections.label: Target audience
sections.heading: Target audience
sections.description: Who the first buyers are, their pains, buying context, and decision criteria.

sections.label: Competitive landscape
sections.heading: Competitive landscape
sections.description: Direct and indirect alternatives, their positioning, pricing, strengths, and gaps.

sections.label: Value proposition
sections.heading: Value proposition
sections.description: The outcome buyers want, what they use today, and what would make this offer credible.

sections.label: Pricing and monetization
sections.heading: Pricing and monetization
sections.description: How similar products charge, typical price points, and willingness-to-pay signals.

sections.label: Acquisition channels
sections.heading: Acquisition channels
sections.description: Where the first customers can be reached and what similar products pay to acquire them.

sections.label: Demand validation
sections.heading: Demand validation
sections.description: Public evidence that people already search for, pay for, and keep using products like this.

sections.label: Unit economics
sections.heading: Unit economics
sections.description: A per-customer model: expected revenue, direct costs, contribution, and payback.

sections.label: Keyword economics
sections.heading: Keyword economics
sections.description: Real search queries, their volume, cost-per-click, and who bids on them — from search services and independent aggregators.

sections.label: Competitor set
sections.heading: Competitor set
sections.description: A bounded comparison sample with sourced profiles, caller-classified roles and separate advertising observations.

sections.label: Channel footprint
sections.heading: Channel footprint
sections.description: Where competitors buy traffic — tracking tags on their pages, ad-library presence and age across platforms, traffic-source split, partner signals.

sections.label: Creative patterns
sections.heading: Creative patterns
sections.description: Observed competitor creative patterns, native dates, current activity, comparison roles and coverage; observations do not establish performance.

sections.label: Funnel teardown
sections.heading: Funnel teardown
sections.description: Browser walks of every distinct funnel behind the shared creative inspection sample, grouped by market, channel and competitor campaign: screenshots, offers, results, approved conversion forms and same-day email. Partial paths, advertising observations and own-product comparison remain explicit; resume unfinished walks.

sections.label: Lifecycle capture
sections.heading: Lifecycle capture
sections.description: What the competitors send after a sign-up: research subscriptions from plus-addressed aliases of the claw mailbox, then the harvested sequences with cadence, offers, discounts and deadlines.

sections.label: Competitor ads
sections.heading: Competitor ads
sections.description: Which competitors pay for ads, where, for how long, and with what offers — from public ad archives.

sections.label: Competitor reviews
sections.heading: Competitor reviews
sections.description: What competitors' paying customers love, complain about, and why they switch — from public review platforms.

sections.label: Communities analysis
sections.heading: Communities analysis
sections.description: Real posts where people ask for, complain about, or price tools like this — from Hacker News, Reddit, and YouTube.

sections.label: Fleet benchmarks
sections.heading: Fleet benchmarks
sections.description: Past experiments from our own launches judged genuinely comparable to this product — internal section.

sections.label: TikTok/Reels market trend research for this product
sections.heading: TikTok/Reels market trend research for this product
sections.description: What is trending around this product's topic on TikTok and Instagram Reels, and which angles are gaining traction.

sections.label: Geography comparison
sections.heading: Geography comparison
sections.description: Compare plausible countries for the next market test, including reachability, adaptation costs and evidence gaps.
